complete.outcome:
**A task can move to a new home and keep its id and history.**

- ✅ `move_item` copies every line of the subtask, with its original time, into the new folder and leaves one `{"task","as"}` reference in the parent ([design](/framework/core/Item/tasks/item-move/design.md), [docs](/framework/core/Item/doc/architecture.md#an-item-moves-home-with-its-id-its-history-and-one-reference))
- ✅ Three ways in: the item tool's `move` key, `spawn_agent` with `task: {from, id}`, and an approved proposal going to its module
- ✅ A refused move writes nothing; a refused handoff is noted in the agent's log
- ✅ Tests: item tool 73, Task 54, Session 7, Item 15, prompt-tasks 21
- ⬜ A verb sent through the old parent still lands in the parent's log (filed as the next task)
